summary.message: Keep track of your houseplants: when each was last watered, fed and repotted, and which ones need water today. It can name a plant from a photo.
summary.keeps: Plants with where they stand and how often they need water, and a log of watering, feeding and notes.
summary.reaches: The model, with a photo you choose, when you ask it to name a plant.

findings.title: Sends a photo to the model when you ask it to name a plant
findings.detail: Only that photo, and only then.

findings.title: Your plants and their log stay inside the tool
